name: m5p2-flymm-fg2
patterns: \[water\] compose stability \(\d+ frames\): frames with a water pass \d+, composed \d+, uncomposed \d+ \(on/off flips \d+\)
expect: \[auto\] scene ready
\[hot\] core generation \d+ loaded
\[ngx\] RR create .*: Success
\[sl\] DLSS-G frame \d+: status 0x0, presented per app frame 2, displayed/rendered over the last \d+ frames 2\.00
\[pace\] rendered frame time over 600 frames
rt passes: GPU cost [0-9.]+ ms/frame \(average of \d+ frames\); TLAS this frame [1-9]\d*, previous frame \d+, none 0
\[cfg\] settings read
\[trace\] frame \d+ written
\[rrpost\] exposure held \(qa_exposure_hold=1\) at EV [0-9.]+
\[water\] water geometry capture on \(rt_water_geometry=1
\[water\] capture \(\d+ frames\): supported draws [1-9]\d*, unknown \d+, excluded \d+ \(flow \d+, VFX \d+\), triangles [1-9]\d*, overflow 0, failed 0
\[water\] families: captured [0-9a-f]{16} FLUID_Water_Plane\w* [1-9]\d* \(Roughness_Base
\[water\] reflections \(\d+ frames, [1-9]\d* traced\): water px (?!0\.00%)[0-9.]+% of [0-9]+ px/frame \(in front (?!0\.00%)[0-9.]+%
\[water\] reflections GPU [0-9.]+ ms median
\[water\] compose record buffer \d+ MB \(\d+ records of 104 B: up to [0-9.]+ Mpx\); patching the audited water FS
\[water\] compose: FS [0-9a-f]{16} patched \(\d+ -> \d+ words, with the sun, local-light and refraction terms\)

\[water\] compose variants \(\d+ frames\): FS patched [1-9]\d*, refused \d+ \([^)]*\), variant pipelines [1-9]\d* \(refused: blend \d+, library \d+; failed 0\), water draws on a variant [1-9]\d*, without \d+
\[water\] compose images \d+x\d+ \(radiance RGBA16F, depth R32F: \d+ MB\)
\[water\] compose \(120 frames, (1[01]\d|120) composed, [0-9.]+ passes/frame\): records [1-9][0-9.]*/frame, owned (?!0\.00%)[0-9.]+%
\[water\] compose energy: mean C [0-9.]+ over owned; composed [0-9.]+% of owned: .*mean delta over owned [-+][0-9.]+ = [-+][0-9.]+% of mean C
\[water\] compose GPU 0\.[0-4]\d\d ms median

\[water\] shadows \(120 frames, [1-9]\d* passes, variant sun\): sun records [1-9][0-9.]*/frame = (?!0\.00%)[0-9.]+% of owned \(no sun term [0-9.]+%, invalid 0\); traced (?!0\.00%)[0-9.]+% of sun records
\[water\] local shadows \(120 frames, \d+ passes with the light list, \d+ without\): local records [0-9.]+/frame
\[water\] refraction \(120 frames, \d+ passes with the colour copy, \d+ without\): transmissive records [0-9.]+/frame
\[water\] rt/water_reflect\.hlsl\?RT_CASCADE_MASKS=1 water_reflect: built
\[water\] rt/water_compose\.hlsl\?\S*RT_CASCADE_MASKS=1\S* water_compose: built
\[water\] compose stability \(\d+ frames\): frames with a water pass \d+, composed \d+, uncomposed \d+ \(on/off flips \d+\)

expect_every.name: capture: supported, no overflow, no failure, every complete chain-on window
composed frames and owned share, every complete chain-on window (static and moving)
expect_every.match: \[water\] compose \(120 frames, (1[01]\d|120) composed, [0-9.]+ passes/frame\): records [1-9][0-9.]*/frame, owned (?!0\.00%)[0-9.]+%

expect_every.name: compose GPU median below 0.5 ms (4 x M5.2's 0.12 ms for the same rays), every complete cost-on window
sun shadows: clamped below one record per frame (window total), every complete chain-on window
local shadows: clamped below one record per frame, every complete chain-on window
refraction: clamped below one record per frame and no unusable copy, every complete chain-on window
scene wait: every cost window traces its own frame's scene (0 timeouts; stale shadows otherwise)
capacity: the RT capture drops no opaque draw (buffer full 0.00) in every traced cost window
capacity: the cascade casters buffer is never full (buffer full 0.0) in every traced cost window with the casters on
compose stability: no water frame left uncomposed (no on/off flip of the reflection and shadows), every complete compose-on window
expect_every.match: frames with a water pass [1-9]\d*, composed [1-9]\d*, uncomposed 0 \(on/off flips 0\)

expect_every.name: non-finite added by water 0: no record with a non-finite composed colour (kept the game's colour, counted), every complete compose-on window

expect_runner: \[motion-plan\] pointer centred in owned foreground game
purpose: M5 promotion, second water scene: Flymm Cargos Basement (Lower City, a flooded basement with light shafts; the save thumbnail shows open water over most of the view; no capture of it yet). Same plan as m5p1 with the local-light view (rt_debug 27) instead of refraction's. Its precheck lines decide validity: a supported water draw, visible water (in front > 0) and a patched variant drawing (water draws on a variant > 0); an unmapped water family keeps the probe and makes the run INVALID for the composition gates (then map that family first). Refraction and local-light participation are reported, not required (a sea plane is opaque).
